title: Capture rewind phase
statement: Fix a mode, a Boolean input word $x$, an allowed input-head position $p$, an arbitrary argument tape content $A$, and Boolean words $c$, $u$, and $v$ such that $c=uv$. Start the finalizer in state $2$, with capture tape storing $c$ from cell $0$ and its head at $|u|-1$, argument head at the origin, and empty output. After exactly $|u|+1$ steps it is in state $3$, with the capture tape unchanged and its head at the origin, argument head still at the origin, and output empty.
replaced:
Let the finalizer run in a fixed mode with capture word $c$, and let $p$ be a prefix of
$c$. Starting from its capture-rewind state with the capture head at cell $|p| - 1$,
after exactly $|p| + 1$ steps it is in the transfer state with the capture head at the
origin, the capture word intact, and the argument head still at the origin.
